anomalies.description: The dashcam vehicle collides with a white bus directly ahead, resulting in a shattered windshield.
The dashcam vehicle collides with a large white bus or truck directly ahead, resulting in immediate and severe windshield shattering.

The windshield is severely shattered with a spiderweb pattern of cracks originating from multiple impact points, indicating a recent collision or impact event.; The vehicle continues driving on a highway with the shattered windshield still in place; no further impact is visible, but the prior crash is evident and the vehicle remains in motion post-accident.

A red cab-over truck in the left lane loses control, swerves sharply right, and collides with a white vehicle ahead in the same lane, causing visible impact and dust/debris. The collision occurs between frames f6 and f10.

A white van on the left side of the road swerves abruptly into the oncoming lane, narrowly avoiding a head-on collision with an approaching dark vehicle; the maneuver suggests loss of control on icy road surface.
A white van collides with a dark sedan at the intersection; the impact causes the white van's driver-side door to swing open and the dark sedan to rotate sharply.
After the collision, two individuals exit the white van and engage in a physical altercation near the front of the vehicle; one appears to push or strike the other.
